name: Sarah Lightner
stance: Sponsors HB 4668, a RAISE-style bill requiring large foundation-model developers to adopt safety protocols against critical risk.

statements.text: Introduced HB 4668, the Artificial Intelligence Safety and Security Transparency Act, requiring large developers to test for and mitigate critical risk (100+ deaths/serious injuries or $100M+ damage), with third-party audits and whistleblower protections.
HB 4668 was re-referred to the House Communications and Technology Committee, where it remains.
